'''K'kur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], K'kur refused to report to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and remained at the [[Almas Academy]], where he died at the hands of [[Phylus Mon]]'s raiders.

==Biography==
Unlike most Jedi of the era, K'kur studied at the [[Almas Academy]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] after being discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] by [[Jedi recruiter|recruiters]] of the Jedi Order's [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]]. Eventually passing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], K'kur went onto become a well-respected [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], known for his prowess with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and his courage in battle. It was surprising to many, then, when K'kur refused the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] call to arms at the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Invoking his [[Right of Denial]] in joining the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], K'kur remained on [[Almas]] instead, answering only to the [[Almas Council|Academy's Council of Masters]].<ref name="AMA" />

While other Jedi died across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of war, K'kur was assigned to protect the ancient [[Almas Sith fortress|fortress]] of the long-dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]]. The fortress, long abandoned, had been captured by the Almas Jedi but had not been completely explored, and was in need of protection from assault by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] sect known as the [[Believers]]. Joined by five other Knights, K'kur was stationed at the south entrance of the fortress while a group of fourteen [[Jedi Researcher]]s explored the interior of the complex. While K'kur was stationed there, a sandstorm swept across the landscape, surrounding the structure. Under cover of the sandstorm, the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Phylus Mon]] led a group of his followers and a Force-sensitive [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] against the fortress. Overpowered, K'kur and the other guards were slain, and the fortress was open to the dark siders. Entering the structure, the raiders preformed a Sith ritual over several hours before leaving the fortress once more.<ref name="AMA" />

Ignorant of the ritual, the researchers reported back to the Almas Council on the mysterious deaths of the guards, resulting in Master [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] organizing three search teams to investigate the fortress and find those responsible.<ref name="AMA" />
